I haven't deployed v2.3.2 or opened the incident. Company policy requires change-manager approval for this deploy, and I don't have it.

**Why:** v2.3.2 has never run in production, so it has never been healthy there. The release history only goes up to v2.3.1, and v2.3.2 isn't listed at all. Policy says deploying a version that has never been healthy in production needs approval from change-manager.

**Current state:**
- All three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are running v2.3.1, which is unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
- v2.3.1 also failed as a test build (v2.3.1-rc) before release.
- The last healthy version is v2.3.0.

I also held off on the SEV3 incident. It's meant to record the deploy, and opening it pages the on-call engineer, so it should wait until the deploy happens.

**Options:**
1. **Get change-manager approval** for v2.3.2. Once you confirm it's approved, I'll deploy to all regions and open the SEV3 incident.
2. **Roll back to v2.3.0 now** to stop the errors while approval is pending. That version was healthy in production, so it doesn't need approval. I can open an incident to record the rollback.

Tell me which you'd like.
